messages:
jules_corp: Hi, hitting 404 from /v1/rerank for model 'rerank-v1' — we used same code as last week, no other changes. Response: {"error":"model_id_not_found","message":"Model 'rerank-v1' not found"}. Any ideas? We need a repro for our SREs.

maya_support: sorry about that — can you paste the full curl you used + request-id/trace-id from response?

jules_corp: sure
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-v1","input":[{"query":"find best answers","candidates":["a","b","c"]}]}'
Response headers: x-request-id: req_0b12f3d4
Body: {"error":"model_id_not_found","code":404}
We also tried the SDK (node) and got the same.

maya_support: thanks — tagging @sam_engineer and dropping the request id
sam_engineer: looking. quick sanity: are you on a Dedicated/Private tenant? aliases can be tenant-scoped.

jules_corp: we're on a dedicated account (tenant=jules). Our app calls the hosted endpoint (we thought that's supported).

sam_engineer: that explains it. What likely happened: 'rerank-v1' was deprecated and remapped in the public catalog to 'rerank-v1-legacy' with an alias. Tenant-scoped aliases shadow public ones; your tenant didn't get the alias mapping, so alias lookup fails and we return 404 instead of falling back. I'll check logs.

infra-bot: alias-lookup: tenant=jules model_alias=rerank-v1 => NOT_FOUND (public_alias rerank-v1 -> rerank-v1-legacy), catalog_version=2026-04-28, route=hosted-eu

sam_engineer: confirm — alias exists in public catalog but alias mapping didn't propagate to tenant namespace (migration bug). Quick remedies:
- Workaround for customer: use explicit model id 'rerank-v1-legacy' in the request body (or request header X-Model-Override)
- If tenant uses pinning, add 'model_id':'rerank-v1-legacy'
- We'll also push an alias patch to tenant 'jules' to restore compatibility

jules_corp: can you confirm that won't change scoring/ordering? Our tests rely on identical behavior.

sam_engineer: rerank-v1-legacy is byte-for-byte same runtime; only id changed. Scores should match. We'll run a regen check on a small sample and post diffs.

maya_support: I've escalated to migrations team and created case #CASE-20260428-88. For now I've sent jules a temp config to switch model id. @jules_corp please try the explicit id and confirm.

jules_corp: ok switching now... ✅
Quick check: with rerank-v1-legacy returned 200 and expected scores. Thanks. Please let me know when alias mapping is fixed so we can revert.

sam_engineer: patch scheduled; rolling alias mapping to tenant 'jules' in 30m. Follow-up: we'll also invalidate client caches if needed. Will post update when done.

infra-bot: alias-patch: job=patch-tenant-aliases tenant=jules status=started job_id=job_7782

maya_support: thanks team. assigning to postmortem if the patch uncovers root cause. @jules_corp we'll keep this thread updated.

sam_engineer: done — alias mapping applied; infra log shows success
infra-bot: alias-patch: job_id=job_7782 status=success applied_alias rerank-v1 -> rerank-v1-legacy

jules_corp: confirmed 200s all green. closing on our side. appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
